12.t: Working with data: body temperature on a hot day
q: State the core temperature after 30 min with water.
Calculate the difference between the two runs at 60 min.
Explain how sweating cools the body.
Sweat evaporates from the skin, taking heat energy from the body.
Explain why temperature keeps rising without water.
The runner becomes dehydrated, so the body makes less sweat (to save water) and cools less; temperature rises towards heat stroke.
